adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts`, the update logic was changed to handle multiple calendar references (`calendarReference = ...filter(...)` and then `for (const reference of calendarReference) { ... updateEvent(...) }`). However, in the merge path (`if (newBookingId)`), it still fetches only a single old reference via `const oldCalendarEvent = booking.references.find((reference) => reference.type.includes("_calendar"));`, implying only one old calendar event will be deleted when merging/rescheduling, potentially leaving other hosts’ old calendar events orphaned.
